purpose: Map the THC genetics/propagation education modules to existing canonical Grow Doc diagnostic profiles without creating duplicate diagnoses.

modules.title: Genetic Identity, Provenance, and Cultivar Claims
modules.reason: Use provenance, mother-stock history, and verified pathogen status as diagnostic context; visual symptoms do not authenticate cultivar identity or confirm viroid status.

modules.title: Crop Planning, Plant Counts, Timing, and Risk
modules.reason: Crop planning should account for transplant readiness, source-stock risk, quarantine, and verified health constraints rather than schedule alone.

modules.title: Mother Stock Health, Records, and Cutting Selection
modules.reason: Mother stock can carry pests and viroids into propagation; use direct inspection/testing and existing differentials.

modules.title: Cutting Selection, Sanitation, Rooting Media, and Auxin Context
modules.reason: Cutting sanitation and rooting-media conditions intersect with existing root-pathogen and root-zone pest differentials.

modules.title: Rooting Environment, Acclimation, Hardening, and Clone Release
modules.reason: Clone release/acclimation requires separating root restriction, moisture/oxygen stress, root pathogens, and root-zone pests.

modules.title: Tissue Culture, Genetic Preservation, Propagation Failure, and CAPA
modules.reason: Propagation-failure investigation should reuse existing pest, pathogen, root-zone and viroid differentials while retaining laboratory confirmation boundaries.
